title: A Deadline for the Safehouse
author: Emrys Voss
blurb: Rafael Delacroix, a private security contractor guarding clients nobody trusts, has spent five years following rules that keep getting rewritten. Then a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must extract a defector who may be the bait, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
